model_annotation: Figure 3 is a pie chart titled “儿童长新闻数量” (Number of Long Children’s News Articles), which visually represents the proportional distribution of long-form news articles for children across eight distinct thematic categories. The chart is divided into eight colored slices, each labeled with a category name and its corresponding percentage: “体育” (Sports) in blue accounts for 14%, “社会” (Society) in orange for 20%, “榜样” (Role Models) in green for 19%, “政治” (Politics) in red for 6%, “文化” (Culture) in teal for 14%, “经济” (Economy) in purple for 21%, “科学” (Science) in yellow for 2%, and “环境保护” (Environmental Protection) in brown for 4%. A legend beneath the chart matches each category to its color. The slices are arranged in a clockwise order starting from the top-right, with the largest slice (“经济”, 21%) positioned prominently, followed by “社会” (20%) and “榜样” (19%). Percentages are displayed directly on or adjacent to each slice, providing clear numerical labels for the visual proportions. No slice is visually exploded or emphasized beyond its proportional size.
